facts.text: The hotel sits on the corner of Peachtree and Piedmont, at Buckhead's busiest intersection.
facts.excerpt: On the corner of Peachtree and Piedmont, the Grand Hyatt Atlanta holds court over Buckhead’s busiest intersection.

facts.text: The hotel's Japanese Zen garden was designed by an award-winning Kyoto architect.
facts.excerpt: plenty of greenery in our garden, designed by an award-winning Kyoto architect

facts.text: The Japanese Zen garden has winding paths, a bridge and a 30-foot waterfall.
facts.excerpt: Give yourself over to tranquility with winding paths, a bridge, the soothing sound of our 30-foot waterfall and plenty of greenery in our garden

facts.text: The Japanese Zen garden includes an azumaya, an open tea house.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s most unusual feature is its feng shui Japanese Zen garden, complete with an azumaya (open tea house) and cascading waterfall.

facts.text: The Zen garden is visible from the restaurant, the lobby bar and the outdoor pool deck.
facts.excerpt: It’s visible from the restaurant and lobby bar, as well as the outdoor pool deck.

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites offer views of the Buckhead neighborhood, Atlanta's skyline, Stone Mountain or the Japanese Zen garden.
facts.excerpt: provides splendid views of the surrounding Buckhead neighborhood, Atlanta's skyline, Stone Mountain or our peaceful Japanese Zen garden

facts.text: Suites can include separate sitting areas, private balconies, wet bars, kitchenettes or extra half-baths.
facts.excerpt: Select one of our luxury suites and enjoy additional amenities such as separate sitting areas, private balconies, wet bars, kitchenettes or extra half-baths.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has views of Stone Mountain and downtown Atlanta, a private balcony with furniture and a regulation-size pool table.
facts.excerpt: Entertain amid views of Stone Mountain and downtown Atlanta in this 2,500 square-foot suite featuring one king bed, a private 450-square-foot balcony with furniture, a regulation-size pool table

facts.text: Pure hypo-allergenic rooms have an air purification system and hypoallergenic treatment of all fabrics and surfaces.
facts.excerpt: an air purification system, hypoallergenic treatment of all fabrics and surfaces, hypoallergenic mattress and pillow covers

facts.text: The Grand Club lounge has a private entry and a dedicated concierge.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Grand Club access with an exclusive private-entry lounge featuring a dedicated concierge

facts.text: The Fabled is a cocktail bar and restaurant beside the garden and waterfall, featuring Georgia ingredients and garden-fresh herbs.
facts.excerpt: The Fabled, beside our serene garden and waterfall, is Atlanta’s cocktail bar and culinary destination. Featuring Georgia’s finest local ingredients, garden-fresh herbs, and Southern elegance

facts.text: Cassis is on the lower lobby level next to the Zen garden, with indoor and outdoor seating.
facts.excerpt: Located on the lower lobby level next to our Zen Garden, Cassis offers a delightful upscale dining experience with indoor and outdoor seating.

facts.text: The 24-hour fitness center has cardio and wellness equipment by Peloton, Technogym and LifeFitness.
facts.excerpt: featuring cardio and wellness equipment by Peloton, Technogym and LifeFitness

facts.text: Peloton bikes can be delivered to guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: to Peloton bike rentals delivered to your room

facts.text: The fitness center has a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Sauna in Fitness Center

facts.text: Guests can join outdoor yoga.
facts.excerpt: joining us for happy hour or outdoor yoga

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs and offers hypoallergenic pet beds and bowls on request.
facts.excerpt: We offer the following for our furry friends on request: hypoallergenic Pet Beds and Pet Bowls.

facts.text: The MARTA Buckhead Station is two blocks from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Buckhead Station is two blocks from our hotel.

facts.text: Buckhead Village District, Lenox Square mall and Phipps Plaza are within minutes of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Or, stay in Buckhead with the world-class shops and restaurants at Buckhead Village District, Lenox Square mall, Phipps Plaza and much more.

facts.text: The hotel draws a significant business and convention crowd.
facts.excerpt: The hotel draws a significant business and convention crowd, as well as fans in town for a big game.

facts.text: Turndown service is provided only on request.
facts.excerpt: If you want turndown service, you have to ask for it.

facts.text: Young children are given rubber duckies with their cribs.
facts.excerpt: They’ll love the rubber duckies they’re given with their cribs.

facts.text: The Nest is a private phone booth for calls near The Fabled.
facts.excerpt: A modern phone booth. A place to step out of the limelight for a quick call or video chat.

facts.text: Wedding and event spaces use the Japanese Zen garden and waterfall as a backdrop.
facts.excerpt: with our Japanese Zen garden and 30-foot waterfall forming a tranquil backdrop for your intimate ceremony, large reception, joyful Indian wedding or other cultural celebration

contradictions.note: p1 says breakfast and dinner are served in the Grand Club; p3 says continental breakfast and evening hors d'oeuvres

sources.excerpt: breakfast and dinner served in the Grand Club each day of their stay
daily continental breakfast, and refined evening hors d’oeuvres
